title: Booking Ray Charles on his first concert
summary: Seeing Ray Charles play dances to poorly dressed crowds, Thomas books him on concerts and proposes a double of Newark and Carnegie Hall.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work
